text:
The mouse eradication on Gough Island first went ahead in **2021**, when the aerial baiting operation was carried out after a planned 2020 attempt was postponed. I haven't checked this against a source in this turn, and I'm not certain about the postponement detail. If "commence" means the wider Gough Island Restoration Programme rather than the baiting, the answer could be 2011.

CONFIDENCE: 65
